key_insight: An integrated AI fiber-orientation tool cuts preparation time for crash CAE from 25 hours to about 0.1 hours while improving component-level crash predictions over an isotropic baseline.
engineering_relevance: Crash CAE engineers can prepare orientation fields directly without molding-specialist support, enabling faster evaluation of glass-fiber-reinforced plastic parts.
method: Support injection-gate selection when gate information is unknown.
Combine voxelization, surrogate inference, automatic CAE mapping, and reporting in one GUI.
Validate from 2D plates to production parts against a predefined angular-error criterion and expert review.
evidence_signal: Reported component-level validation reduced absolute peak-force error from 19.0% to 11.4% versus an isotropic baseline and confined predicted fracture to the test-observed region.
watch_item: Deployment remains initial and limited to directed fracture-prediction scenarios; broader applicability is not established by the abstract.
paper_title: From AI Surrogate to Engineering Tool: Toward Production Use of Fiber-Orientation Prediction in Crash CAE
